entries.sentence_en: A haven built against the apocalypse had a weakness at its own entrance, and warmer weather found it.
entries.sentence_zh: 一座为抵御世界末日而建的避难所，在自家入口处却有一个弱点，并且更暖的天气找到了它。
entries.old_table_definition: 本文：避难所；n. 避风港，庇护所（a safe haven）
